correctness.rationale: The source group structures give a normal perfect SL(2,5) factor, hence the derived subgroup. The outer Galois kernel intersects it in the central C2. Three full branch values and the order-60 special inertia reduce the remaining full inertia orders to unique Riemann--Hurwitz solutions. Their images in the cyclic abelianization are forced to have full coprime orders, and a second Riemann--Hurwitz computation gives genera 1,2,4. The exact arithmetic is independently replayed inside the package; no finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The quotient by the commutator subgroup is the canonical maximal abelian quotient attached to the full automorphism action, not an arbitrary subgroup slice. Identifying it as genus 1, 2 and 4 with exact cyclic triangle signatures exposes the low-genus abelian geometry hidden inside three very high-genus icosahedral plane curves and gives natural quotient maps whose Jacobians inject by pullback into the source Jacobians. This is a structural invariant of the source examples rather than a routine parameter substitution.
